t: The Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Shank Mixed Impact Bit Set is a 15-piece puck box accessory line designed for heavy-duty drilling and fastening. Ideal for professional tradespeople tackling demanding tasks on construction sites or in workshops, these impact driver bits feature laser-hardened Wearguardtip technology for improved wear resistance and a precise fit. Optimised Shockzone geometry flexes to reduce stress and minimise breakages by absorbing impacts. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these bits offer increased resistance to shock from high-torque impact driving.
